Sect: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}

A renegade cult that broke from the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ssX4b2JFXF2uegC3]{Followers of Set}, the Serpents of the Light claim origins in the West Indies rather than Egypt, distancing themselves from their parent clan's traditions. Early Serpents found protection from their hostile forebears within the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}, and lasting animosity between the two groups grew until the Serpents declared total independence. They practice manipulation through seduction, exploiting a target's vice - drugs, sex, power, or otherwise - to bring them under control, generally working through minions and from the shadows.

Disciplines: Obfuscate, Presence, Serpentis

Advantage: Every Setite gains one bonus Streetwise Ability Trait and a level of Political, Street or Underworld Influence.

Disadvantage: Setites are sensitive to light. Sunlight always inflicts an extra health level of damage, and bright artificial light (spotlights, flares, floodlights) causes a one-Trait penalty on all challenges.

Organization: Serpents of the Light operate through networks of dupes and minions, rarely revealing themselves directly, and maintain a bitter rivalry with the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ssX4b2JFXF2uegC3]{Followers of Set} wherever the two cross paths.
